name: io.github.jessysw/contitext
title: Contitext
description: Self-hosted project continuity for AI agents: state, decisions, checkpoints, and handoffs.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: SQLAlchemy postgresql+psycopg:// URL for your migrated PostgreSQL 16+ database. See setup instructions.

environmentVariables.name: CONTITEXT_AUTH_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Required only in config authentication mode: protected token-to-principal JSON mapping.

environmentVariables.name: CONTITEXT_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: This client credential, valid in the selected authentication mode. Membership and project ACLs are required.

environmentVariables.name: CONTITEXT_AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: config (default) or database. Database mode accepts managed credentials only.

environmentVariables.name: CONTITEXT_COMPATIBILITY_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit workspace for short project IDs. Without it use workspace/project. Never selects a conversation project.
